name: Marcianise (Italy)
description: Blue field with a white central panel bordered yellow, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Marcianise (a tower on green) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Marcianise, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Marcianise arms — tower on green, crowned, within branches
